name: Open Exchange Rates
summary: Foreign exchange rates for 170+ currencies: latest, historical end-of-day back to 1999, time series and conversion.

api_key.description: An Open Exchange Rates App ID (openexchangerates.org/account/app-ids). Sent as the app_id query parameter.

notes: The default base is USD; other bases need a paid plan.
Every call counts against a monthly request quota (usage.json and currencies.json do not); update frequency depends on the plan.
All dates and timestamps are UTC.

endpoints.name: Get the latest exchange rates
endpoints.summary: Rates for every currency against one base, as of the latest update on your plan.

base.description: Base currency, 3-letter code; default USD. Paid plans only.

symbols.description: Comma-separated 3-letter codes to limit the rates returned.

show_alternative.description: Add alternative, black-market and digital currency rates.

notes: Changing base needs a paid plan; symbols and show_alternative work on every plan.
timestamp is Unix seconds; rates are units of each currency per 1 base.

endpoints.name: Get exchange rates for a past date
endpoints.summary: End-of-day rates (last published values of that UTC day) for any date since 1999-01-01.

base.description: Base currency, 3-letter code; default USD. Developer, Enterprise and Unlimited plans.

symbols.description: Comma-separated 3-letter codes. Developer, Enterprise and Unlimited plans.

show_alternative.description: Add alternative, black-market and digital currency rates.

notes: Asking for today's UTC date returns the latest rates, not an end-of-day value.

endpoints.name: Get daily rates over a period
endpoints.summary: Daily rates for every day between two dates (both inclusive), at most one month per call.

end.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD; an invalid calendar day is moved back to the nearest valid one.

symbols.description: Comma-separated 3-letter codes; recommended, responses are large.

show_alternative.description: Add alternative, black-market and digital currency rates.

notes: Each day in the range counts as one request against the monthly quota; request longer spans month by month.

endpoints.name: Convert an amount between currencies
endpoints.summary: Converts a value at the latest rate, returning the rate and timestamp used.

endpoints.name: List currency codes and names
endpoints.summary: Every 3-letter currency code the API offers with its full name.
notes: Keyless; does not count towards usage.

endpoints.name: Get the App ID's plan and usage
endpoints.summary: Plan name, monthly quota, features and requests used and remaining this month.
notes: Does not count towards usage. Unlimited accounts report quota and remaining as -1.
